## Custom colors

Settings → Appearance now includes color pickers and hex values for the player marker and glow, last known position, pet ranks, resources, feathers, teleport locations, dungeons, strongholds, custom pins and routes.

Colors save automatically and apply to the main map, floating minimap and pet cards. Each color has its own reset; Reset all colors restores the original palette without changing other settings or collection progress.

Original game icons remain visible, with custom map colors applied as marker accents.
